title: 龙泰资管郝洪：科技硬件与AI领涨，传统行业承压，市场内部分化加剧
speaker: How Home

segments.en: Yeah, well I think if you look at the general overall Chinese market index, it hasn't done much this year, it's lagging behind the US peers.
segments.zh: 是的，我认为如果你看整体中国市场指数，今年表现平平，落后于美国同行。

segments.en: But then if you look at the China export and also the star 50 for example, many of the Chinese tech hardware stocks are actually listed on this exchange and they're doing exceedingly well.
segments.zh: 但如果你看中国出口和科创50指数，许多中国科技硬件公司都在这个交易所上市，表现非常出色。

segments.en: And also if you look at the Chinese exports, if you look at the tech hardware, semiconductor related sectors, export growth is up year-on-year, 40-50 percent, and export price is surging as well.
segments.zh: 此外，中国出口中科技硬件、半导体相关领域，出口同比增长40-50%，出口价格也在飙升。

segments.en: So that is telling you that there's a huge divergence that is going on in the internal structure of the market. Basically the tech hardware is doing well, AI names are doing well, but then the traditional industries are doing less well.
segments.zh: 这说明市场内部结构存在巨大分化。科技硬件表现好，AI相关公司表现好，但传统行业表现较差。

segments.en: So that is telling you that there's a huge divergence that is going on in the internal structure of the market. Basically the tech hardware is doing well, AI names are doing well, but then the traditional industries are doing less well.
segments.zh: 所以市场内部结构分化巨大，科技硬件和AI股表现强劲，而传统行业则相对疲软。
